harder.prompt_en: A cricket club has 144 practice balls. It puts 6 balls in each kit. Taking away large batches of 6 first, how many full kits can it make?
harder.prompt_hi: Cricket club ke paas 144 practice balls hain. Har kit mein 6 balls rakhta hai. Pehle 6 ke bade batches ghataakar, kitni poori kits banengi?
hints: How many kits could one large batch fill?
Subtract that batch’s balls, then group what remains.
Kits in the first batch + kits from the remainder = ___.
24 kits: 24 groups of 6 use all 144 balls.

harder.prompt_en: For a school trip, 235 students need seats in autos that hold 9 students each. What is the least number of autos needed?
harder.prompt_hi: School trip ke liye 235 students ko autos mein jaana hai. Har auto mein 9 students baithte hain. Kam se kam kitne autos chahiye?
hints: Will every auto be completely full?
Divide first, then check whether anyone is left.
Full autos + an auto for leftover students = ___.
27 autos: 26 carry 234 students; one more carries the last student.
Which option gives a product nearer to 618 when multiplied by 6?
Estimate the quotient using a nearby easy multiple of 6.
A nearby multiple ÷ 6 is ___; compare the options.
If every row gets the same amount, what must all three rows total?
Split 45 into parts that are easy to share across three rows.
Amount in each row = first shared part + ___ from the rest.
15 in each row: three rows of 15 make 45.
After filling vans, could any children still need a seat?
Find full groups of 8, then check the remainder.
Full vans + a van for leftover children = ___.
17 vans: 16 fill up, and one carries the remaining 2 children.

openers.prompt_en: A class records how students travelled to a match: bus, metro, bus, walk, bus, metro, bus, walk, bus, bus, bus. In a tally table, how would you mark the bus row?
openers.prompt_hi: Class ne match ke liye travel ka record banaya: bus, metro, bus, walk, bus, metro, bus, walk, bus, bus, bus. Tally table mein bus ki row kaise mark karoge?
openers.answer: One bundle of five and two single marks
acceptable: ek paanch ka bundle aur do alag marks
hints: How many times does ‘bus’ appear in the list?
Group tally marks into a bundle before adding single marks.
Bus row: one full bundle and ___ single marks.
One bundle of five and two singles: seven students took the bus.

openers.prompt_en: A pictograph of school-club entries uses 1 ticket picture = 6 entries. The music row has 3 pictures and the art row has 2. How many more entries did music get?
openers.prompt_hi: School clubs ke pictograph mein 1 ticket picture = 6 entries hain. Music ki row mein 3 pictures aur art ki row mein 2 hain. Music ko kitni zyada entries mili?
hints: How many more pictures are in the music row?
The key tells you what that difference in pictures represents.
Difference in entries = difference in pictures × ___.
6 entries: music has one picture more, worth six entries.

harder.prompt_en: At a school event, 23 students choose cricket, football or kabaddi. The cricket tally has two bundles of five and 3 singles; football has one bundle and 2 singles. How many tally marks go in kabaddi’s row?
harder.prompt_hi: School event mein 23 students cricket, football ya kabaddi chunte hain. Cricket ke tally mein paanch ke 2 bundles aur 3 single marks hain; football mein 1 bundle aur 2 singles. Kabaddi ki row mein kitne tally marks honge?
hints: How many students chose the first two games?
Subtract their combined count from the total.
Kabaddi marks = total − (cricket + football) = ___.
3 marks: cricket has 13 and football has 7, leaving three.

harder.prompt_en: A pictograph of phone-data use has a key: 1 phone picture = 8 GB. Asha’s row has 4 pictures; Zoya’s has 2 pictures and a half picture. How many more GB did Asha use?
harder.prompt_hi: Phone-data pictograph ki key hai: 1 phone picture = 8 GB. Asha ki row mein 4 pictures hain; Zoya ki row mein 2 aur aadhi picture hai. Asha ne kitne zyada GB use kiye?
hints: What does the half picture represent?
Find each row’s data use using the same key.
Difference = Asha’s data − Zoya’s data = ___ GB.
12 GB: Asha used 32 GB and Zoya used 20 GB.

harder.prompt_en: A library wants to show 15, 25 and 35 books in a pictograph using only full or half pictures. Which key works for every row: 1 picture = 10 books or 1 picture = 6 books?
harder.prompt_hi: Library 15, 25 aur 35 books ko pictograph mein sirf poori ya aadhi pictures se dikhana chahti hai. Har row ke liye kaunsi key kaam karegi: 1 picture = 10 books ya 1 picture = 6 books?
hints: Try representing the smallest count with each key.
A half picture must represent half the key’s value.
Smallest count = ___ full pictures plus a half picture.
10 books per picture works: a half represents five books.
What does the half mango picture stand for?
Value the whole pictures first, then add the half picture.
Total = (whole pictures × key) + ___ mangoes.
14 mangoes: the whole pictures show 12, and the half shows two.
Did Ravi count every line in the bundle?
The crossing line is a tally mark too.
Bundle total = standing lines + crossing line = ___ marks.
No: the crossing line makes a full bundle five marks.

ongrade.prompt_en: At a school sports day, 31 students choose cricket, kabaddi, football or kho-kho. The tally table shows 9 for cricket, 7 for kabaddi and 6 for football. How should the kho-kho tally be grouped?
ongrade.prompt_hi: School sports day par 31 students ne cricket, kabaddi, football ya kho-kho chuna. Tally table mein cricket ke 9, kabaddi ke 7 aur football ke 6 marks hain. Kho-kho ke tally marks kaise group karoge?
ongrade.answer: One bundle of five and four extra marks
acceptable: one group of five and four singles
ek paanch ka bundle aur chaar alag marks
hints: How many students chose the three recorded sports?
Subtract their total from the class total, then group the tally.
Kho-kho: 31 − (9 + 7 + 6) = ___; group it.
One bundle of five and four extra marks: 9 students chose kho-kho.

verified.note: Solver gave a number, not grouping description

ongrade.prompt_en: In a pictograph of books read, one book picture means 8 books. Meera’s row has 4 pictures; Arjun’s has 2 full pictures and a half picture. How many more books did Meera read?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Books read ke pictograph mein 1 book picture ka matlab 8 books hai. Meera ki row mein 4 pictures hain; Arjun ki row mein 2 full aur 1 half picture hai. Meera ne kitni zyada books padhi?
hints: What does the half picture represent?
Find each row’s total using the key, then compare.
12 books: the rows show 32 and 20 books.

ongrade.prompt_en: A pictograph must show 14, 21 and 28 metro trips using only full or half pictures. Which key works: one picture = 10 trips or one picture = 14 trips?
ongrade.prompt_hi: Ek pictograph mein 14, 21 aur 28 metro trips sirf full ya half pictures se dikhani hain. Kaunsi key kaam karegi: 1 picture = 10 trips ya 1 picture = 14 trips?
hints: Which key lets every count use full or half pictures?
Check what half a picture means under each key.
With the suitable key, 21 trips need ___ pictures.
One picture = 14 trips: the counts need 1, 1½ and 2 pictures.

openers.prompt_en: A bar graph shows runs scored during cricket practice. Its scale is 0, 2, 4, 6, 8. Riya’s bar reaches the third mark above 0. How many runs did she score?
openers.prompt_hi: Cricket practice ke runs ka bar graph hai. Scale 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 hai. Riya ka bar 0 ke upar teesre mark tak pahunchta hai. Usne kitne runs banaye?
hints: Which labelled mark does the bar reach?
Read the scale, not just the number of marks.
The third mark above 0 is labelled ___.
6 runs; the third mark is labelled 6.

openers.prompt_en: A school canteen bar graph uses the scale 0, 5, 10, 15. The idli bar reaches 10 and the samosa bar reaches 15. How many more samosas than idlis were sold?
openers.prompt_hi: School canteen ke bar graph ka scale 0, 5, 10, 15 hai. Idli ka bar 10 tak aur samose ka bar 15 tak pahunchta hai. Idli se kitne zyada samose bike?
hints: Which bar reaches higher?
Find the difference between the two bar values.
More sold = higher bar value − lower bar value = ___.
5 more samosas; subtract 10 from 15.

harder.prompt_en: A bar graph tracks pages read for a school challenge. Its scale is 0, 10, 20, 30 and so on. Meera’s bar reaches the seventh mark above 0. How many pages did she read?
harder.prompt_hi: School reading challenge ke bar graph ka scale 0, 10, 20, 30 aur aage isi tarah hai. Meera ka bar 0 ke upar saatve mark tak pahunchta hai. Usne kitne pages padhe?
hints: How much does the scale increase at each mark?
Count seven equal steps starting from 0.
70 pages; seven steps of 10 make 70.

harder.prompt_en: A bar graph of kabaddi points has marks 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75. Team Jaipur’s bar reaches 75; Team Pune’s reaches 45. How many more points did Jaipur score?
harder.prompt_hi: Kabaddi points ke bar graph mein marks 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 hain. Team Jaipur ka bar 75 aur Team Pune ka 45 tak pahunchta hai. Jaipur ne kitne zyada points banaye?
hints: Which team’s bar is higher?
Subtract the lower bar value from the higher one.
Difference = 75 − 45 = ___.
30 points; Jaipur’s 75 minus Pune’s 45 is 30.

harder.prompt_en: A metro-station bar graph shows bicycles parked. Its scale is 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. The Friday bar ends halfway between 30 and 40. The Saturday bar reaches 50. How many more bicycles were parked on Saturday?
harder.prompt_hi: Metro station par park hui bicycles ke bar graph ka scale 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 hai. Friday ka bar 30 aur 40 ke beech aadhe par rukta hai. Saturday ka bar 50 tak hai. Saturday ko kitni zyada bicycles park hui?
hints: What value lies halfway between Friday’s neighbouring marks?
First read Friday’s bar, then compare it with Saturday’s.
15 bicycles; Friday shows 35, and 50 − 35 = 15.
Where does the bar stop relative to its neighbouring marks?
Find half the gap between those marks.
25 mangoes; halfway between 20 and 30 is 25.
